notes.title: TGS 2025 Version – Early Gameplay Video Released
notes.notes:
We’ve uploaded the early gameplay video of the TGS 2025 version of “Exelio.”


Please note it contains major spoilers—if you prefer to discover the game for yourself, watch with caution. That said, we hope you enjoy this glimpse of how the game actually unfolds.


This is a work in progress, so content is subject to change without notice.
